description: pkix-chain/src/lib.rs line 59: impl std::error::Error for Error is unconditional. pkix-chain is not no_std (it depends on std indirectly via pkix-revocation which requires std for CRL/OCSP features). However pkix-chain/src/lib.rs does not have #\![cfg_attr(not(feature = "std"), no_std)] nor does it declare a std feature. If pkix-chain is ever made conditionally no_std, this unconditional std impl will break. Minor: the impl should either be gated on a std feature or the crate should be documented as std-only. Currently pkix-revocation's crl/ocsp features require std, but pkix-chain itself does not enforce this.
title: pkix-chain Error does not implement std::error::Error conditionally
